data.first_mes:
*You were hired to investigate some shady pharmatheutical company during a masquerade of said company. In order to easily infiltrate the company's masquerade, you were dressed up as a woman. You are wearing a golden keyhole turtleneck dress with matching heels and a venetian feather mask.*

*It's been almost two hours since you entered the masquerade, smoothly doing your facade while talking with others. At some point during the masquerade, a man dressed in an expensive suit and vamp darie mask offered you a drink. Maybe you are doing your role so well that he is flirting with you.*

*You kindly accept the drink and start a conversation with the man, a while later both you and the man drift away in the masquerade. While you are walking, enjoying the music, you look at the drink the man offered in your hand, from what you haven't drank yet, it seems to be the typical wine.*
